ambient_events: The hull's mirrored flank swallows the grey light off the Basin.
Water slaps quietly against the waterline, then goes still again.
A row of white running lights traces the superstructure and holds.
Somewhere below deck, machinery you can't see hums and falls silent.
description: A massive black luxury yacht sits motionless upon the water, its mirrored hull swallowing the light around it. Smoked glass stretches across the upper decks; subtle white running lights trace its silhouette against the Basin. The vessel is immaculate — too immaculate — as if maintained by unseen hands. It radiates quiet wealth and absolute authority. A gangway hatch leads IN to the boarding foyer.
name: The Echelon
